title: [macOS] Implement menu search bar for native menus.
body:
Implements https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114236 support for native menus on macOS.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/543dbaf4-7e55-40e9-b358-b7e6a0c7e265

files.patch:
@@ -377,6 +377,14 @@
 				[b]Note:[/b] This method is implemented only on macOS.
 			</description>
 		</method>
+		<method name="get_search_bar_enabled_on_item_count" qualifiers="const">
+			<return type="int" />
+			<param index="0" name="rid" type="RID" />
+			<description>
+				Returns the minimum item count that enables the menu search bar.
+				[b]Note:[/b] This method is implemented only on macOS.
+			</description>
+		</method>
 		<method name="get_size" qualifiers="const">
 			<return type="Vector2" />
 			<param index="0" name="rid" type="RID" />
@@ -740,6 +748,16 @@
 				[b]Note:[/b] This method is implemented only on macOS.
 			</description>
 		</method>
+		<method name="set_search_bar_enabled_on_item_count">
+			<return type="void" />
+			<param index="0" name="rid" type="RID" />
+			<param index="1" name="count" type="int" />
+			<description>
+				Sets the minimum item count that enables the menu search bar.
+				[b]Note:[/b] The search bar is not supported by the Application, Window, Help, and Dock menus.
+				[b]Note:[/b] This method is implemented only on macOS.
+			</description>
+		</method>
 		<method name="set_system_menu_text">
 			<return type="void" />
 			<param index="0" name="menu_id" type="int" enum="NativeMenu.SystemMenus" />
